text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, the Trainers gathered to hold 
an after-party celebrating the end of 
their debut races.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Now that our trainees have safely made 
their debuts, first of all, great work 
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I thought her debut would be a little 
further down the line, but Meek really 
gave it her all...!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
We were also able to make our debut in 
peak condition, without pushing beyond our 
limits.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This is Trainer Riko Kashimoto. She has 
experience managing Umamusume in the past, 
making her a senior trainer to us.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I know the real challenge starts now, but 
for now, we've gotten past one major 
hurdle.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I've watched Trainer Kashimoto's training 
sessions before, but—

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Even the pace and workload are 
meticulously calculated. It's truly 
thorough, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"Just as no two days are the same, 
Umamusume change day by day as well."

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Monitoring their subtle changes and 
reflecting that in their training each 
time... ...That is my method.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Trainer Kashimoto is a trainer known for 
her strictly controlled management.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her sharp, piercing gaze often seems to 
make her appear unapproachable, but...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Even so, it's not as if I want to tie down 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I let them do what they want as much as 
possible. Assessing their condition on top 
of that is my job, I believe.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Whether it's management or making 
decisions, I still have a long, long way 
to go...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"So to speak, we truly have reason to be 
grateful for the existence of the Three 
Goddesses."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
To make up for my lack of experience, I 
need to absorb as much knowledge as 
possible!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I feel the same. Even with plenty of 
experience, one always desperately craves 
more knowledge.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Rookie or veteran, the weight of the 
dreams an Umamusume carries remains the 
same.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are! Trainer Kashimoto, 
thank you for your hard work!!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, it's a bit early for training 
to start... but there's something I'd like 
to consult you about. Do you have a 
moment?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course. I'll be right over.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"...Now then. Let us continue to do our 
utmost for the sake of the Umamusume in 
our charge."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Yes, let's do our best!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Trainers who keep on running for the sake 
of their Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at Trainer Kiryuin and Trainer 
Kashimoto, I resolved once again to build 
a relationship of mutual trust with my 
Umamusume and run alongside her.
